metadata.description: Claude Code mods for everyday tasks, installable from this plugin marketplace

plugins.name: english-improver
plugins.description: After each prompt, shows how a native speaker would write it, with short notes

plugins.name: adb-explorer
plugins.description: Browse, pull, push and clean files on an Android device over adb, in an /adb-explorer pane

plugins.name: mac-cleaner
plugins.description: See what's using space on your Mac and move the junk to the Trash, from a /mac-cleaner pane

plugins.name: mac-uninstaller
plugins.description: Uninstall Mac apps with the files they leave behind, from a /mac-uninstaller pane

plugins.name: mac-caffeinater
plugins.description: Keep your Mac awake for a while, until a time, or while an app runs, from a /mac-caffeinater pane

plugins.name: mac-monitor
plugins.description: Your Mac's CPU, memory, disk and battery in a line above the prompt, with details in a /mac-monitor pane

plugins.name: note-taker
plugins.description: Keep notes in a /note-taker pane, the same notes as on your own Note Taker page on claude.ai
